description: The single Fly volume becomes a multi-customer SPOF once paid users exist. Add per-user backups, monitoring/alerting (sync failures, synthesis errors, volume capacity, webhook failures), a public status page, and a support channel (email is fine at launch). Start in parallel with billing. Defer-acceptable for a soft launch but required before meaningful paid volume.
title: Ops hardening for multi-customer hosting: per-user backups, monitoring, status page, support
